summary: In the United States, Everolimus has a boxed warning for harm to the immune system, blood vessels, and kidneys (nephrotoxicity) [3]. The drug's warning labels also call for watching for infections and non-infectious lung inflammation (pneumonitis), which may require pausing or stopping the drug depending on severity [5]. Additionally, some clinical trials stopped early due to extreme or unexpected levels of harmful effects [7][8]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Everolimus a medium risk score for liver harm and a low risk score for heart harm [M].
